claim_evidence.assumption: The committed archival snapshot is the publication baseline
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Every hard foreign key resolves before analyses run
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Referential completeness is not exhaustive coverage of every concert or optional layer
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: 3341 Show rows, 40757 Performance rows, 645 Song rows
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Venue and song slugs normalize names but do not prove real-world identity

claim_evidence.assumption: A performance row is a setlist-entry unit, not a duration unit
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Empty setlists remain in the denominator
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: The statistic describes metadata density, not musical length or quality
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: Per-show counts of ordered Performance rows, including zero-row shows
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Set and position fields are source-derived ordering metadata
claim_evidence.validation_artifact: performance_distribution figure dataset and distribution tests

claim_evidence.assumption: Segment markers are set structure rather than repertoire items
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: drums, space, tuning, feedback, and jam markers are surfaced but excluded from song rankings
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: A high count is not a preference, importance, or aesthetic claim
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: Song performance counts after generic segment-marker exclusion
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Canonical song aliases are conservative and title-based

claim_evidence.assumption: Item-level resampling is an uncertainty display, not a population model
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Gini and top-decile statistics are computed from observed item counts only
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Intervals do not estimate unseen concerts or listener behavior
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: Ranked song-performance counts and venue-show counts
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Bootstrap intervals resample items with a fixed deterministic seed

claim_evidence.assumption: Within-show adjacency is meaningful setlist structure
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Only first-order next-song transitions are modeled
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Transition probabilities are not causal or predictive laws
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Permutation screening controls false discoveries for supported cells

claim_evidence.assumption: Source segue notation is sparse but semantically stronger than plain adjacency
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Only explicit source markers create segue edges
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Unmarked segues and audio-continuity evidence are outside this corpus
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Unmarked adjacency remains visible in the transition model
claim_evidence.validation_artifact: segue_edges output and segue_graph figure dataset

claim_evidence.assumption: Show-level co-presence is a useful association signal
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Centrality uses Jaccard-normalized co-occurrence rather than raw frequency
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Association centrality is not influence, authorship, or musical similarity
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Top-song heatmaps are size-limited for legibility

claim_evidence.assumption: Era-weighted count profiles can reveal inspectable repertoire neighborhoods
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Centered SVD and deterministic clustering use fixed seeds and stable tie-breaks
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Clusters are pattern-discovery aids, not definitive musicological taxonomy
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: Era-by-song log-count profiles with segment markers excluded
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Top-N songs are selected to keep labels readable at manuscript size

claim_evidence.assumption: Setlists and lineups can be modeled as finite categorical structures
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Functor monotonicity and naturality checks are machine-evaluated
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Formal coherence does not prove cultural or musical explanation
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: Finite date poset, performance spans, and lineup intervals
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: The abstraction preserves incidence and cumulative cardinality, not audio semantics

claim_evidence.assumption: Venue-level aggregation is the appropriate unit for geographic views
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Figures use only venues with resolved coordinates
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Slug-level venue counts are lower bounds per physical building when aliases remain
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: 912 venue slugs plus committed geo sidecar rows
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Alias collapse is precision-oriented and intentionally incomplete
claim_evidence.validation_artifact: geo_scatter figure dataset; completeness venue-geo check

claim_evidence.assumption: Pointers can support metadata-level interpretation without reproducing protected text
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: No lyric text or audio features are bundled
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Overlay counts are not representative samples of all lyrics or reviews
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: LyricPointer URLs, curated theme tags, and sourced review sentiment rows
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Theme and sentiment overlays are curated/partial by design

claim_evidence.assumption: Official, archival, and scholarly sources are stronger anchors than secondary summaries
claim_evidence.hard_constraint: Contextual sources do not create Show, Performance, or Recording rows
claim_evidence.interpretation_limit: Contextual overlays explain why dates matter but do not alter computed counts
claim_evidence.irreducible_input: Stable citation keys and cited contextual milestones
claim_evidence.soft_constraint: Timeline milestones are selected orientation anchors
claim_evidence.validation_artifact: references.bib; bibliography parser; rendered citation checks
